title: Successive prefix parity
statement: Let $m$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $w$ be a Boolean string of length $m+2$. If $k<m+2$, then the parity of the first $k+1$ entries of $w$ is the parity of the first $k$ entries plus, in $\mathbb{F}_2$, the encoding of the entry at position $k$.
